description: This is a Java class file defining the response to a 'DeleteAttribute' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates the status, headers, and specifics of the deleted attribute, and provides methods for creating, parsing, and manipulating such responses.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a DeleteAttribute command, including serialization/deserialization and validation logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DeleteAttributeResponse instance with specified ThingId, attribute pointer, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a DeleteAttributeResponse instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the deleted attribute.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path of the response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends relevant JSON fields to the payload for serialization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
